producer_report.summary:
Athena now writes no `Athena-` trailers in commits built on a parent whose `athena.toml` names `[history] cutover_job` (after C0). The strip is in one function, `message_for_parent` (commits.rs). `build_commit_in` calls it for every commit Athena builds, and so does the staged-intervention commit in manage.rs, which uses `git commit`. Without `cutover_job`, nothing changes.

Other changes:
- **Gate:** `athena-gate` `invariant::check` accepts trailer-free commits after C0, judged by content. A commit that adds an intervention record counts as a declared intervention. A commit that changes nothing governed but touches `records/` counts as naming existing work. A governed change with no record is still refused. Only the parent's own `athena.toml` counts; a parent with none is judged by the built-in config, which names `cutover_job`.
- **Landing lookup and squash text:** `gh::landed_commit_for` finds a post-C0 job's landed commit from its records (the commit that added `outcome-landed.json`, else `outcome.json`, with a matching fingerprint). `land_pr` uses it. `Git::squash_text_relaxed` accepts 0 or 1 `Athena-Job` trailer and refuses more.
- **`retry_landing`:** after C0 it does no trailer search, has no "closing commit not found" bail, and writes no `Athena-Verified-Content`.
- **Readers:** the status trace adds the commits that touch the job's records plus the landing host commit. The auditor's `read_changed_files` falls back to the host commit named by the landing record. A trailer-only lookup, `auditor::read_changed_files_by_trailers`, is public so a test can show it fails on a fresh clone.
- **Tests:** new `crates/athena-cli/tests/trailer_stop.rs` (four tests on the k0tt `CutoverFixture`), a gate test, `commits.rs` strip tests, and `athena-git` tests for the relaxed squash text and for `replay` keeping a trailer-free message.
- **Docs:** CHANGELOG entry, and a new entry D133 at the end of `docs/decisions.md` (design, gate rule, alternatives, `retry_landing`, replay note). The log is append-only and a test checks it, so an addendum inside D111 failed that test.

Test results: the full suite passed before I added the gate unit test and the docs. After that I reran only the gate invariant tests, the decision-log tests, the `backtest` test and the `trailer_stop` tests, and they pass. clippy and `cargo fmt --check` were clean when last run.

criteria_check.criterion: A test on the cutover fixture lands a new job branch (intervention commit, records-only commit, job landing) through land_pr with a squash merge. The squash commit on main and the three pull-request commits reached from the records branch have no Athena- lines. The landing record classifies them. check --history and check --attribution report no violations. Run: cargo test -p athena-core.
criteria_check.evidence: Test `post_c0_landing_through_land_pr` in crates/athena-cli/tests/trailer_stop.rs passes. It uses Athena::intervene with staged changes, ask, go, then land_through_pr (land_pr with FakeHost squash). It asserts no Athena- line on the squash commit, the local landing, or any commit in the landing record, and the kinds (DeclaredIntervention first, JobLanding last, RecordsOnly between). It runs the real binary's `athena check --history` and `--attribution`, expecting 0 violations and 0 findings. Two deviations: the test is in athena-cli, so `cargo test -p athena-core` does not run it (run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test trailer_stop` instead). And the landing record has five commits, not three, because ask and go commit three records-only commits (reading, dispatch, and so on), so the test asserts the shape rather than exactly three.

criteria_check.criterion: A test covers retry_landing for a blocked job after C0: no trailer search, no 'closing commit not found' bail, and no Athena-Verified-Content written. Run: cargo test -p athena-core retry_landing.
criteria_check.evidence: `retry_landing_after_c0_searches_no_trailer_and_writes_none` in trailer_stop.rs blocks a post-C0 job with a local edit, resolves it, and calls go. It asserts Landed, no 'Athena-' text in the new commit, outcome-landed.json present, and `landed_commit_for` returns the retry commit. The retried job is then landed through land_through_pr. The counterpart `retry_landing_without_a_cutover_job_still_writes_trailers` passes. Both pass with `cargo test -p athena-cli --test trailer_stop`; the `-p athena-core` filter would find no test.

criteria_check.criterion: Tests call athena status's trace and the auditor through their real entry points on a post-C0 job and get correct results. Run: cargo test.
criteria_check.evidence: `post_c0_job_is_read_by_the_trace_and_the_auditor` passes. Athena::trace returns state 'landed', an outcome, and a commits line starting with the squash commit's short hash. In a fresh clone (main and athena/records fetched), `read_changed_files_by_trailers` fails with 'none could be read', then `Athena::audit` succeeds and records an audit for the job. The full `cargo test --locked` ran in this session; the only failures were the ones fixed afterwards.

criteria_check.criterion: With no cutover_job configured, trailers are written as before. All existing tests pass, cargo clippy is clean and cargo fmt --check passes. Run: cargo test, cargo clippy, cargo fmt --check.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks. For my part: the full `cargo test --locked --no-fail-fast -q` run before the last two edits (the gate unit test and the docs) had only the one gate failure, which I fixed. A later run showed only the decisions-log and backtest failures from my first docs edit, which I fixed by appending D133; both pass now. I also reran the gate invariant tests, `trailer_stop` and the `decisions` tests, and they pass. `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --all --check` were clean when last run. I changed two test configs to drop `cutover_job` so existing trailer tests still run: `test_config()` in crates/athena-cli/tests/common/mod.rs and `config()` in run_pin_tests.rs. The repo's own athena.toml names a cutover job, so without that they would have stopped seeing trailers.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has an entry, and docs/decisions.md records the D111 trailer-stop design, the alternatives and the retry_landing post-C0 behavior. It removes the stale 'retry_landing has no test' statement.
criteria_check.evidence: CHANGELOG.md has an Unreleased/Added entry. docs/decisions.md has a new entry D133, appended at the end, covering the design, gate rule, readers, retry_landing post-C0, replay note, alternatives and tradeoff. The decision-log tests (`the_decision_log_is_well_formed_and_only_appended_to`, `backtest`) pass.

criteria_check.criterion: The fixture is the k0tt helper, with a job landed the old way through the real writers. No hand-built records are substituted.
criteria_check.evidence: The tests call `common::cutover_fixture()`, which calls the existing `CutoverFixture::build`. Later jobs are made only with Athena::intervene, ask, go and land_through_pr. There is no new hash_object or commit_tree use. The only test_support.rs edits are `make_athena` made pub and `land_through_pr` choosing the squash text by config.

open_issues: Departure from the plan: the new tests are in crates/athena-cli/tests/trailer_stop.rs, not in athena-core. Core cannot build the `change` capability or the fake-agent scenarios. So `cargo test -p athena-core post_c0_landing_through_land_pr` and `... retry_landing` match nothing. Run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test trailer_stop`; `cargo test --locked` runs them. Moving them under -p athena-core needs a core-side capability and scenario helper, or a dev-dependency on athena-cli.

Files outside the brief's list that I changed: crates/athena-core/src/manage.rs (the staged-intervention commit), crates/athena-core/src/run_pin_tests.rs, crates/athena-cli/tests/common/mod.rs, and the new tests/trailer_stop.rs. The two test-config edits drop `cutover_job` so existing trailer tests keep passing.

code_health.rs counts landings by the `Athena-Job` plus `Athena-Verified-Content` trailers (around line 369). After C0 it sees none. That is a reader outside this job's list; it needs its own change, for example counting landings from records.

The plan's 'exactly [DeclaredIntervention, RecordsOnly, JobLanding]' is not met literally. A job's ask and go add three records-only commits, so the landing record has five commits. The test asserts the first, last and middle kinds instead.
`Git::replay` is unchanged, as planned: a branch commit built before the setting was on its parent keeps its trailers. This is documented in D133.

The trace post-C0 uses `git log -- <job dir>` and the landing host commit. It does not search the records branch for other commits. I did not test an auditor run where athena/records has no tip; that path returns an error text naming the missing landing record.

docs/decisions.md D133 states 'No text with the words retry_landing has no test exists'. That is my reading; I did not find such text via Grep of decisions.md for retry_landing (no hits), and did not grep CHANGELOG.md for it.
mistakes: I first inserted the decisions addendum inside D111; that broke the append-only test and the backtest line pins. I removed it and appended D133 instead.

I first keyed the gate on judged.config, which falls back to the built-in config naming cutover_job. That made a repo with no athena.toml look post-C0. I changed it to read the parent's own athena.toml.
The first intervention commit still carried a trailer, because `intervene --with-staged` commits with git directly. I added the strip to that path too.
My first test version assumed exactly three pull-request commits. The landing record has five, so the test now asserts the shape.
learnings: The repository's own athena.toml already sets [history] cutover_job, and athena-gate's BUILTIN_CONFIG includes it. Any test config built from it, and any gate judging a parent with no athena.toml, looks post-C0 unless the line is dropped.

docs/decisions.md is append-only and checked by a test with a prefix hash. backtest.rs also pins D43 and D115 by line number, so inserting text inside an existing entry fails both. New text must go at the end.
The cutover job's CutoverSpec already exists in core's test_support.rs, but core has no capability or scenario helpers, so the fixture can only be built from athena-cli tests.

athena-core's tests cannot reach `change` or the cli Scenario helper. A dev-dependency cycle would work only for integration tests, and common/mod.rs uses env!(CARGO_BIN_EXE_athena), which athena-core does not define.
intervene without --with-staged still adds an intervention record, so classify_pre_merge calls it a DeclaredIntervention, not RecordsOnly. The records-only commits come from ask and go.
A blocked job's closing commit is a records-only commit and carries no trailers even before C0.
desires: A fake-capability and scenario helper in athena-core's test support, so core tests could run whole jobs and `cargo test -p athena-core <filter>` would find the new tests.
A way to run `cargo test` output filtered to failures, since tail/grep are not permitted and the full output is truncated.
